rows.grounds: compound of saṃvatsara (year), ādi (beginning), and khelā (sport/festival), object in the series of observances
conjunction connecting items in the list
compound of vasanta (spring) and ākhya (named/called), qualifying the festival
compound of tad (that) and utsava (festival), referring to the spring festival

items.question: Which additional festival observances are included among the prescribed ritual celebrations?
premises: The verse continues an enumeration of ritual observances.
A festival marking the beginning of the year is included.
A festival known as the spring festival is also included.
items.inference: The prescribed celebrations include the year-beginning festival and the festival called the spring festival.
uncertainties: The exact ritual character of saṃvatsādikhelā is not specified beyond being a festival or sport.
items.plain_english: And also the year-beginning festival, and that festival known as the spring festival.
